svg.title: the greeble-to-web fillet among the bodies around it

g.text: detail 2 — the greeble-to-web fillet, in both branches of its conditional
left U=3.0 end_bolt 1/8in, right U=0.75 end_bolt 1/8in — same panel, so only the size flips the branch; each scaled to its own fillet
grey is the finished octant, teal the plain flange material, purple the bolt-flange fillet, amber the web-to-bolt, red this one
the reference switches and it changes nothing: in both, the bodies around the fillet already supply everything it
would add — net zero in 33 of the 44 variants measured, at most 0.042 mm³ in the rest.
its lower edge is not the web face: the body is squared off below the tangent point, so 67% of it lies
inside the web — the same fraction in every variant. In the right-hand one the bolt hole then removes what is left,
which happens in 5 of the 44, all at U ≤ 1.0; above that the body stays, as on the left.
